product.name: Regular-Fit Sports Tank Top with DryMove™
product.description: Regular-fit sports tank top in functional fabric made with DryMove™ to wick away moisture from skin and keep you comfortably dry while moving. Round, ribbed neck and slightly longer hem at back. Four-way stretch for added comfort and freedom of movement.
